notes: College of Arts and Humanities' Philosophy Four Year Academic Plan. The source PDF's term grid converts to garbled, column-interleaved text (Fall/Spring cells for four years run together with Gen Ed labels), so exact per-slot Fall/Spring placement could not be reliably reconstructed; flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md. Term placement here follows the plan's clearly-legible signals (a logic course and an intro PHIL course in Year 1, 'PHIL 3xx-4xx' slots concentrated in Years 3-4, 'PHIL 4xx' slots in Year 4) and otherwise spreads the 12 required PHIL courses across the 8 terms in roughly the plan's own listed order. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.

None of the source's 'PHIL 1xx-4xx', '(Logic)', 'PHIL 3xx-4xx' or 'PHIL 4xx' slots name a specific course number (see reviewNotes on the Program -- the requirement's topic buckets are approximated with disjoint number bands since the engine can't verify topic). All 12 slots are filled with real PHIL course numbers from the Academic Catalog's approved-course list (main session, not the owner's source), matching each requirement's band: PHIL170 (Logic, 100-199); PHIL201, PHIL204, PHIL209, PHIL220, PHIL234, PHIL250 (History/Value Theory/Metaphysics-Epistemology combined bucket, 200-299, 6 courses); PHIL308, PHIL320, PHIL362, PHIL408, PHIL440 (Philosophy Electives, 300-499, 5 courses) -- chosen only to satisfy each bucket's band, not verified against actual course titles for topical fit.
